Exrx.net - Has an exercise directory and detailed lists of muscular functions, reviews of literature on programming and injury prevention. Similar to what you'd learn to become certified as a personal trainer.

YouTube - If you want to learn an exercise the quick and easy way. Spend some time watching videos by big names like Alan Thrall, Chad Wesley Smith, Diesel Crew, Scott Hermann, etc. Then for other things you have Redefining Strength, Calisthenic Movement, and tons and tons of yoga instructors.
